## History

Varley was a widely traveled author of works such as Edgewood Days, The Rosebud Garden, and Golden Keys, though every one of her initial stories had originally been turned down. She eventually resided in [Toronto](../codex/places.md#toronto), where she was known as a superb raconteur. During a trip, she joined [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll hosted by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P29](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0029), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), +3 more_
